name: calf-raise-barbell-seated
title: Calf Raise: Barbell (Seated)
primer: This version of a calf raise uses a block and a barbell.
steps: Place a block on the floor about one foot in front of a bench.
Sit on the bench with a barbell across your upper thighs and the balls of your feet on the block.
Slowly raise your heels as high as possible without lifting your feet off the block, then lower them.
